## Checklist

- [ ] Title uses [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org).
- [ ] Commits are **signed (verified)**.
- [ ] `make test` (markdownlint + lychee + vale) passes locally and in CI.
- [ ] Links are relative and valid; tables render; Mermaid diagrams render on GitHub.
- [ ] Cross-references updated (`README.md` / `CATALOG.md` / related `docs/`).
- [ ] AI config (`CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md` / Copilot / Cursor) still consistent if touched.
- [ ] If this changes `docs/SECURITY-BASELINE.md`, I requested `@aircloud/security` review and
      described the enforcement/rollout impact.
